# A remote picture on bubbletea, snapshotted after a wait: the test draws its
# view as the program does, so the fetch starts at the first draw and the
# picture is there by the snapshot. A test drew the view only to snapshot,
# so the first snapshot started the fetch and showed blank cells where the
# program, which draws every frame, shows the picture; !275's screenshots
# took a snapshot first to start the fetches.
#
# Confirmed against the codegen before: the snapshot was blank cells.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
grep '▀' app.sngl.snapshots/picture.ansi

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component picture ui.node {
    ui.image(style={width=64px, height=32px}) {
        ui.remote(url="http://127.0.0.1:47819/dot.png")
    }
}

func testPicture(t test.Test, c picture) {
    t.wait(func() => false, 1000)
    t.snapshot("picture")
}

ui.window {
    picture
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/picture/1 --
sha256:c89b04d62099f0036d8ed11ed254aca1

  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "Picture",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ],
  "snapshots": {
    "picture.ansi": ""
  }
